calendar.title: Align to calendar cycle
calendar.description: Reset budgets and rate limits at the start of each period (e.g. 1st of month) instead of rolling from creation date. Quarterly budgets always align to fiscal quarter starts. Applies to durations of a day or longer.
calendar.warningDescription: Enabling calendar alignment will reset budget usage to <1>$0.00</1> and token/request rate-limit counters to <3>0</3> for this {{owner}}, then snap each reset date to the start of its current period (e.g. start of day, week, month, or year). The usage reset cannot be undone, but calendar alignment can be turned off later. This will take effect when you save.
